descriptor.scene: Maya alone at the rim: she stands at the low stone rail of the terrace, seen from three-quarters BEHIND at medium distance on the left of frame, head and torso pointed the same way, out and down toward the green sea of jungle far below. Her right hand has just opened: one crisp WHITE page slips from it into the bright air below the rail, caught by the light, its small neat writing suggested by soft fine lines that are not readable at this distance. The page is falling toward the world she came from, and it is not smudged. Her laptop rests on the rail under her left hand. The terrace behind her is quiet gold; the jungle below is soft and far. Keep the lower right calm: open sky and the falling page's empty air. CRITICAL GEOGRAPHY: Maya is STANDING ON the one floating island; therefore NO island, rock or city may appear in the sky. The sky beyond the rail is empty warm air and soft cloud, and far below lies only the flat green sea of jungle.
descriptor._caption: Maya remembers the pages that fall and smudge. So she writes her story plainly and checks every word before she sends it down. I worked hard, and hard work was not enough. A friend found the way and told me first. Find the friends who would tell you. Be one back.
negatives: readable letters, words or numbers on the page
Maya's chest or the front of her blazer visible
a floating island, floating rock or city anywhere in the sky

MAYA: a founder, half-Black and half-white, in her sage-olive single-button notch-lapel blazer with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, plain WHITE crew-neck tee, STONE KHAKI chinos (never blue jeans, never denim trousers), white sneakers, and a closed silver laptop carried under her left arm. Earnest, capable, warm. Warm-editorial ink-and-wash, never photoreal. Identity of record; wardrobe and features exactly as the locked sheets. founder-heaven exactly as its reference plate: A floating protopian island in open sky above the jungle. Underneath, a gentle teardrop of pale rock trailing thin skirts of mist. On top, terraced gardens stepping up from the rim, low cream buildings with warm windows, slender brass wind-spires, small orchards and pools. It floats free: no chains, no pillars, no engines. Two fixed camera angles: ESTABLISHING (from below, over the jungle canopy) and TERRACE (standing on a rim garden terrace looking along the edge, jungle far below like a green sea). From below, the island sits high in the frame with canopy or clearing in the lower third; it is never close enough to read individual doors. On the terrace, the rim rail and the drop beyond it carry the height; buildings stay low and behind, sky stays generous. Pale terraced stone, green gardens, low cream buildings with warm windows, brass wind-spires, soft banners without lettering, drifting small clouds. Futuristic reads as graceful and quiet, never chrome, never neon, never engines or thrusters. The island reads about the size of a small hill town: whole gardens and rooftops are visible at once from below, and birds passing near it read as specks. From the terrace, the jungle below reads as a soft green sea with no individual trees. THE ONLY CHARACTERS IN THIS IMAGE ARE: maya. NOBODY ELSE APPEARS. Do not add any other person, figure, creature, robot, animal or bystander, whatever the style description above may suggest. ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FULL-BLEED PAINTING that fills the entire canvas edge to edge. This is NEVER a grid, NEVER a multi-panel layout, NEVER a comic page, NEVER a contact sheet, NEVER a study or turnaround sheet, NEVER a collage, and NEVER several framed views side by side. Some reference images supplied to you are multi-panel study sheets; use them ONLY for the identity and design of what they depict, and NEVER copy their panelled layout into the output. The output has exactly ONE camera, ONE moment, and NO internal borders, frames, gutters, or dividing lines of any kind. HANDS. Every hand in this image has EXACTLY FOUR FINGERS AND ONE THUMB, five digits and no more and no fewer, and every person has exactly TWO hands and TWO arms. No sixth finger, no extra thumb, no duplicated or spare limb, and no hand emerging from a place no arm reaches. Two hands that come near each other stay SEPARATE and readable as two hands: they never merge into one mass, never share fingers and never fuse at the knuckles. Each hand is joined to a wrist of believable thickness, the wrist to a forearm, and the forearm to the shoulder of the person it belongs to. Hands are sized to their owner: never oversized, never doll-small. A hand resting ON something makes real contact with THAT thing, with the fingers following its actual surface and not floating above it or sinking into it.
